_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); railroad signals

pit_profile.why: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not

classification.quality_note: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.63x; +57% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.15; conservative 2yr -17%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -7.7%/yr (worst year FY09-FY18, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +1.3%/yr (Q2 2019 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +17.4%/yr (FY09-FY18 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +34.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY09-FY18); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNP (retrospective, 2019-10-11) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.63x (43.0% downside to Bear $92 / +26.4% upside to Bull $204) | Adj composite 1.90 vs market 3.05: gap -1.15 [OVERVALUED] | +57% above the EPP floor $103 (13x FY19E $7.91) | Conservative 2-yr case: -17.1% total (-8.5%/yr) | At 20.4x FY19E the 15% hurdle price $213 sits above the BULL case; carloads -4% in Q2 2019, forward revenue -2% (no FY19 revenue guide, Q2 2019 freight revenue); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
